title: Rosemary Beach: Ro Sham Beaux in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Ro Sham Beaux is a sweet little two bedroom plus bunk getaway in the heart of Rosemary Beach, filled with plenty of color and happy to make your stay a little more cheerful. Book today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Renovated Spring 2021 - all new furnishings and appliances.

Ro Sham Beaux is a sweet little two bedroom plus bunk getaway in the heart of Rosemary Beach, filled with plenty of color and happy to make your stay a little more cheerful.

Sitting on the penthouse level of the Lofts, Ro Sham Beaux offers views of East Long Green and the famous Blue Dog statue that don't disappoint. Ride the elevator for some retail therapy in Town Center or stroll to the green on Sundays for the Farmers Market. The beach at Walkover E or F is less than 5 minutes walking with two adult bicycles available complimentary to guests of Ro Sham Beaux.

Guests will find all the things that make vacation easier, more enjoyable, and of course helpful. The goodness of home sweet home and more: plenty of games and puzzles for family fun, tons of hangers for clothing, lots of hooks and bars to hang swimsuits and beach towels, kids' plates/cups/cutlery/etc., loads of serving platters/pitchers/cocktail necessities and of course all the small appliances you need to cook it up in the kitchen.

The fully-stocked kitchen has plenty of counter space to prepare meals plus appliances ranging from a handheld milk frother to a roomy fridge to store beach snacks and beverages. Four bar stools provide casual dining space or additional seating steps from the dining room's seating for six. A cute (and functional) bar cart rounds out the space.

The living room features a deep-seated sofa that doubles as more sleeping space with a pull-out queen and two plush velvet chairs.

Ro Sham Beaux's spacious corner balcony acts as an extension of the dining and living rooms. Enjoy morning coffee or sunset cocktails. The outdoor dining table and conversation area easily seat six guests.

It's all in the details; all the cozy + comfy bedding and mattresses for rest after full days of beachside fun. Ro Sham Beaux's master bedroom is full of color, texture and unique accents paired with practical necessities like a full-length mirror, blackout lined shades and easily accessible plug-ins for electronics. The master bedroom also features a flat-screen television with sound bar, plenty of drawer space and a walk-in closet. An en suite bathroom compliments the master bedroom with a double vanity, soaking tub, walk-in shower, and water closet.

The guest room is just as accommodating. That's right, another flat-screen tv and full-length mirror plus good drawer and hanging space for a week at the beach. Even the kiddos will love the unit's coziest set of built-in bunks with drawer spaces for swimsuits and jammies. A hall bath with shower/tub combination service the guest bedroom, bunk and sleeper sofa occupants.

Come visit soon friends !
Rental Includes:

- 2 complimentary adult bikes

- Complimentary Access to Rosemary Beach Fitness & Tennis

- High Speed Wi-Fi

- Access to 4 Distinct Community Pools

- SONOS Soundbar, Subwoofer and Roku Remote

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
